name: HA-VLN 2.0
description: HA-VLN 2.0 is a unified benchmark for human-aware vision-and-language navigation in dynamic, crowded environments. It introduces social-awareness constraints, a dataset with multi-human interactions, and standardized tasks and metrics capturing goal accuracy and personal-space adherence, supporting safe and socially responsible navigation research.
reputation: A specialized benchmark for socially aware navigation that is relevant to embodied AI research, but it is still relatively new and not yet a widely standardized leaderboard benchmark.
notes: Includes real-world robot experiments validating sim-to-real transfer; provides open leaderboard and standardized protocols.
